basis: Early nodulin-75-like HRGP; ENOD2 in situ marks nodule parenchyma in pea and soybean (van de Wiel et al. 1990 EMBO J)
validation: in situ localization shown for the pea and soybean orthologs (nodule parenchyma); the Medicago gene itself was not localized

basis: Repetitive proline-rich cell-wall early nodulin of the infection program (Journet et al. 2001 MPMI)
validation: pMtENOD11-gusA transgenics: expressed at pre-infection and infection stages in root and nodule tissues (also in arbuscule-containing cells)

basis: Proline-rich early nodulin marking cells preparing for rhizobial infection (Pichon et al. 1992 Plant Cell)
validation: in situ hybridization in nodule cell layers ahead of the infection zone; promoter-GUS in differentiating root epidermis 3-6 h after inoculation

basis: BOP-type co-regulator that maintains nodule identity at the nodule vascular meristem; ortholog of LjNBCL1 and PsCOCH1 (Magne et al. 2018 Plant Physiol)
validation: noot1 loss of function produces ectopic roots from nodule vascular meristems; the noot1 noot2 double mutant loses nodule identity

basis: NBCL2-clade BOP paralog expressed in the nodule central meristem (Magne et al. 2018 Plant Physiol)
validation: expressed mainly in the nodule central meristem; noot1 noot2 double mutants lose nodule identity

basis: PLETHORA AP2 TF of the root stem-cell program, reused in the central nodule meristem (Franssen et al. 2015 Development)
validation: expressed in the central nodule meristem; nodule-specific PLT knockdown reduces nodule number or stops meristem activity

basis: PLETHORA AP2 TF of the root stem-cell program, reused in the central nodule meristem (Franssen et al. 2015 Development)
validation: expressed in the central nodule meristem; nodule-specific PLT knockdown reduces nodule number or stops meristem activity

basis: PLETHORA AP2 TF at the nodule meristem periphery (Franssen et al. 2015 Development)
validation: expressed at the meristem periphery next to nodule vascular bundles, overlapping MtWOX5; PLT knockdown reduces nodules or meristem activity

basis: [Lateral root primordium (and nodule primordium)] LBD TF shared by lateral root and nodule initiation, NIN target (Schiessl et al. 2019 Curr Biol)
validation: pLBD16-GUS in LR and nodule primordia; lbd16-1 Tnt1 mutant fewer LR primordia and nodules (Schiessl 2019)

basis: [Root stem cell niche (also nodule meristem periphery)] PLETHORA ortholog in root/nodule meristems, function shown in nodule (Franssen et al. 2015 Development)
validation: pMtPLT1-GUS in root tip stem cell region and nodule meristem; PLT knockdown impairs nodule meristem (Franssen 2015)

basis: [Root stem cell niche (also nodule meristem periphery)] PLETHORA ortholog in root/nodule meristems (Franssen et al. 2015 Development)
validation: pMtPLT2-GUS in root tip stem cell region and nodule meristem (Franssen 2015)
